title: Support Desk Note on Invitation Payments — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**Rule.** A payment sent from a Pocketwire Personal Account to a phone number or email with no Pocketwire account is an invitation (recipient status unclaimed invitation) and stays with Pocketwire until the recipient claims it, which is booked as a claimed payment. An invitation payment is refunded only if it has not been claimed; the sender may cancel an unclaimed invitation at any time, and an invitation still unclaimed the plan's unclaimed payment expiry in calendar days after its transaction date is refunded automatically on the next handling. The expiry is counted in calendar days from the invitation payment's transaction date, the day after sending being day 1, and a refund on the day the expiry is reached qualifies. The refund returns the full payment amount to the balance as one payment refund pointing to the invitation payment, whatever its original funding source, and any credit card funding fee charged on it is refunded as a fee refund. A claimed invitation, or a payment to a registered recipient, is never refunded by Pocketwire.

**Basis.** Whether an invitation has been claimed, or already refunded, is read from the account's system record of claims and refunds pointing to that invitation payment.

| Invitation payment | Refund by Pocketwire |
|---|---|
| Unclaimed, cancelled by the sender | Refunded in full |
| Unclaimed on or after the day the expiry is reached | Refunded in full automatically on the next handling |
| Claimed by the recipient | Never |
| Already refunded | Not refunded again |
| Payment to a registered recipient (not an invitation) | Never |

**Expiry boundary (hypothetical, a 30-day expiry)**

- Sent on day 0 and still unclaimed on the 30th calendar day after: refunded on a handling on that day.
- On the 29th calendar day after sending the expiry has not been reached.

**Worked refund (hypothetical).** A 75.00 invitation funded by a linked credit card with a 2.25 credit card funding fee is refunded as 75.00 to the balance, and the 2.25 fee is refunded as a fee refund.
